name: Financial Assistance to the Fish Vendors Registered with the Directorate of Fisheries to Purchase the Accessories Required for Fish Vending
benefit:
> **For General Category**

50% subsidy, limited to ₹10,000, on a unit cost of ₹20,000.
> **For SC/ST/Woman Category**

60% subsidy, limited to ₹12,000, on a unit cost of ₹20,000.
**NOTE:** The beneficiary can avail of the scheme once every three years.
_eligibility_text: The applicant should be a Fish Vendor registered with the Department of Fisheries, Government of Goa.
